[P2] Distinguish transient files from configured session storage

The blanket claim that replacement instances have no files from earlier jobs conflicts with the existing `AgentcoreSessionConfig` documentation in `packages/aws-durable-execution-sdk-js-extensions/src/compute/agentcore/types.ts`, which explicitly limits file loss to files outside configured session storage. Readers configuring that storage receive contradictory guidance about whether their files survive instance replacement. Qualify this paragraph and its idle-timeout advice as applying to process memory and transient files, preserving the configured-session-storage exception.
